                          <div class="meetings-intro"><p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the third (3rd) Wednesday of each month, commencing at 3pm. Meetings are not held in the month of January.</p>
<p>Members of the public are encouraged to attend Council meetings. Specific guidelines and procedures apply to the asking of questions at a Council meeting. The <a href="https://www.cranbrook.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/Public-Question-Time-Rules.pdf">guidelines for Public Question Time can be downloaded here</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Recording of Meetings</strong></p>
<ul data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)">
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">All Council Meetings are digitally recorded, for audio only, except for Confidential Agenda Items (in accordance with Section 5.23(2) of the Local Government Act 1995) during which time recording ceases.</li>
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">Following publication and distribution of the meeting minutes to Council Members the digital audio recording will be available on the Shire’s website.</li>
</ul>
<div data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)"></div>
<p><u data-ogsc="">Defamation – cl 14K Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996</u></p>
<p data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)" data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)"><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(1)          A local government is not liable to an action for defamation in relation to any of the following done by the local government as required or authorised under this Part —<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(a)          publicly broadcasting a meeting;<br />

                          <div class="meetings-intro"><p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the third (3rd) Wednesday of each month, commencing at 3pm. Meetings are not held in the month of January.</p>
<p>Members of the public are encouraged to attend Council meetings. Specific guidelines and procedures apply to the asking of questions at a Council meeting. The <a href="https://www.cranbrook.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/Public-Question-Time-Rules.pdf">guidelines for Public Question Time can be downloaded here</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Recording of Meetings</strong></p>
<ul data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)">
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">All Council Meetings are digitally recorded, for audio only, except for Confidential Agenda Items (in accordance with Section 5.23(2) of the Local Government Act 1995) during which time recording ceases.</li>
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">Following publication and distribution of the meeting minutes to Council Members the digital audio recording will be available on the Shire’s website.</li>
</ul>
<div data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)"></div>
<p><u data-ogsc="">Defamation – cl 14K Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996</u></p>
<p data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)" data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)"><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(1)          A local government is not liable to an action for defamation in relation to any of the following done by the local government as required or authorised under this Part —<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(a)          publicly broadcasting a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(b)          making a recording of a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(c)          making a recording of a meeting publicly available;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(d)          retaining a recording of a meeting or a copy of a recording;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(e)          providing a copy of a recording of a meeting to the Departmental CEO.</span></p>
</div>

                          <div class="meetings-intro"><p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the third (3rd) Wednesday of each month, commencing at 3pm. Meetings are not held in the month of January.</p>
<p>Members of the public are encouraged to attend Council meetings. Specific guidelines and procedures apply to the asking of questions at a Council meeting. The <a href="https://www.cranbrook.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/Public-Question-Time-Rules.pdf">guidelines for Public Question Time can be downloaded here</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Recording of Meetings</strong></p>
<ul data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)">
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">All Council Meetings are digitally recorded, for audio only, except for Confidential Agenda Items (in accordance with Section 5.23(2) of the Local Government Act 1995) during which time recording ceases.</li>
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">Following publication and distribution of the meeting minutes to Council Members the digital audio recording will be available on the Shire’s website.</li>
</ul>
<div data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)"></div>
<p><u data-ogsc="">Defamation – cl 14K Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996</u></p>
<p data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)" data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)"><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(1)          A local government is not liable to an action for defamation in relation to any of the following done by the local government as required or authorised under this Part —<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(a)          publicly broadcasting a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(b)          making a recording of a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(c)          making a recording of a meeting publicly available;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(d)          retaining a recording of a meeting or a copy of a recording;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(e)          providing a copy of a recording of a meeting to the Departmental CEO.</span></p>
</div>

                          <div class="meetings-intro"><p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the third (3rd) Wednesday of each month, commencing at 3pm. Meetings are not held in the month of January.</p>
<p>Members of the public are encouraged to attend Council meetings. Specific guidelines and procedures apply to the asking of questions at a Council meeting. The <a href="https://www.cranbrook.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/Public-Question-Time-Rules.pdf">guidelines for Public Question Time can be downloaded here</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Recording of Meetings</strong></p>
<ul data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)">
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">All Council Meetings are digitally recorded, for audio only, except for Confidential Agenda Items (in accordance with Section 5.23(2) of the Local Government Act 1995) during which time recording ceases.</li>
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">Following publication and distribution of the meeting minutes to Council Members the digital audio recording will be available on the Shire’s website.</li>
</ul>
<div data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)"></div>
<p><u data-ogsc="">Defamation – cl 14K Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996</u></p>
<p data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)" data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)"><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(1)          A local government is not liable to an action for defamation in relation to any of the following done by the local government as required or authorised under this Part —<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(a)          publicly broadcasting a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(b)          making a recording of a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(c)          making a recording of a meeting publicly available;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(d)          retaining a recording of a meeting or a copy of a recording;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(e)          providing a copy of a recording of a meeting to the Departmental CEO.</span></p>
</div>

                          <div class="meetings-intro"><p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the third (3rd) Wednesday of each month, commencing at 3pm. Meetings are not held in the month of January.</p>
<p>Members of the public are encouraged to attend Council meetings. Specific guidelines and procedures apply to the asking of questions at a Council meeting. The <a href="https://www.cranbrook.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/Public-Question-Time-Rules.pdf">guidelines for Public Question Time can be downloaded here</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Recording of Meetings</strong></p>
<ul data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)">
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">All Council Meetings are digitally recorded, for audio only, except for Confidential Agenda Items (in accordance with Section 5.23(2) of the Local Government Act 1995) during which time recording ceases.</li>
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">Following publication and distribution of the meeting minutes to Council Members the digital audio recording will be available on the Shire’s website.</li>
</ul>
<div data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)"></div>
<p><u data-ogsc="">Defamation – cl 14K Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996</u></p>
<p data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)" data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)"><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(1)          A local government is not liable to an action for defamation in relation to any of the following done by the local government as required or authorised under this Part —<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(a)          publicly broadcasting a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(b)          making a recording of a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(c)          making a recording of a meeting publicly available;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(d)          retaining a recording of a meeting or a copy of a recording;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(e)          providing a copy of a recording of a meeting to the Departmental CEO.</span></p>
</div>

                          <div class="meetings-intro"><p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the third (3rd) Wednesday of each month, commencing at 3pm. Meetings are not held in the month of January.</p>
<p>Members of the public are encouraged to attend Council meetings. Specific guidelines and procedures apply to the asking of questions at a Council meeting. The <a href="https://www.cranbrook.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/Public-Question-Time-Rules.pdf">guidelines for Public Question Time can be downloaded here</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Recording of Meetings</strong></p>
<ul data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)">
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">All Council Meetings are digitally recorded, for audio only, except for Confidential Agenda Items (in accordance with Section 5.23(2) of the Local Government Act 1995) during which time recording ceases.</li>
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">Following publication and distribution of the meeting minutes to Council Members the digital audio recording will be available on the Shire’s website.</li>
</ul>
<div data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)"></div>
<p><u data-ogsc="">Defamation – cl 14K Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996</u></p>
<p data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)" data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)"><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(1)          A local government is not liable to an action for defamation in relation to any of the following done by the local government as required or authorised under this Part —<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(a)          publicly broadcasting a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(b)          making a recording of a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(c)          making a recording of a meeting publicly available;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(d)          retaining a recording of a meeting or a copy of a recording;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(e)          providing a copy of a recording of a meeting to the Departmental CEO.</span></p>
</div>

                          <div class="meetings-intro"><p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the third (3rd) Wednesday of each month, commencing at 3pm. Meetings are not held in the month of January.</p>
<p>Members of the public are encouraged to attend Council meetings. Specific guidelines and procedures apply to the asking of questions at a Council meeting. The <a href="https://www.cranbrook.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/Public-Question-Time-Rules.pdf">guidelines for Public Question Time can be downloaded here</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Recording of Meetings</strong></p>
<ul data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)">
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">All Council Meetings are digitally recorded, for audio only, except for Confidential Agenda Items (in accordance with Section 5.23(2) of the Local Government Act 1995) during which time recording ceases.</li>
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">Following publication and distribution of the meeting minutes to Council Members the digital audio recording will be available on the Shire’s website.</li>
</ul>
<div data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)"></div>
<p><u data-ogsc="">Defamation – cl 14K Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996</u></p>
<p data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)" data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)"><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(1)          A local government is not liable to an action for defamation in relation to any of the following done by the local government as required or authorised under this Part —<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(a)          publicly broadcasting a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(b)          making a recording of a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(c)          making a recording of a meeting publicly available;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(d)          retaining a recording of a meeting or a copy of a recording;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(e)          providing a copy of a recording of a meeting to the Departmental CEO.</span></p>
</div>

                          <div class="meetings-intro"><p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the third (3rd) Wednesday of each month, commencing at 3pm. Meetings are not held in the month of January.</p>
<p>Members of the public are encouraged to attend Council meetings. Specific guidelines and procedures apply to the asking of questions at a Council meeting. The <a href="https://www.cranbrook.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/Public-Question-Time-Rules.pdf">guidelines for Public Question Time can be downloaded here</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Recording of Meetings</strong></p>
<ul data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)">
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">All Council Meetings are digitally recorded, for audio only, except for Confidential Agenda Items (in accordance with Section 5.23(2) of the Local Government Act 1995) during which time recording ceases.</li>
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">Following publication and distribution of the meeting minutes to Council Members the digital audio recording will be available on the Shire’s website.</li>
</ul>
<div data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)"></div>
<p><u data-ogsc="">Defamation – cl 14K Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996</u></p>
<p data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)" data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)"><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(1)          A local government is not liable to an action for defamation in relation to any of the following done by the local government as required or authorised under this Part —<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(a)          publicly broadcasting a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(b)          making a recording of a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(c)          making a recording of a meeting publicly available;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(d)          retaining a recording of a meeting or a copy of a recording;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(e)          providing a copy of a recording of a meeting to the Departmental CEO.</span></p>
</div>

                          <div class="meetings-intro"><p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the third (3rd) Wednesday of each month, commencing at 3pm. Meetings are not held in the month of January.</p>
<p>Members of the public are encouraged to attend Council meetings. Specific guidelines and procedures apply to the asking of questions at a Council meeting. The <a href="https://www.cranbrook.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/Public-Question-Time-Rules.pdf">guidelines for Public Question Time can be downloaded here</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Recording of Meetings</strong></p>
<ul data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)">
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">All Council Meetings are digitally recorded, for audio only, except for Confidential Agenda Items (in accordance with Section 5.23(2) of the Local Government Act 1995) during which time recording ceases.</li>
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">Following publication and distribution of the meeting minutes to Council Members the digital audio recording will be available on the Shire’s website.</li>
</ul>
<div data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)"></div>
<p><u data-ogsc="">Defamation – cl 14K Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996</u></p>
<p data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)" data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)"><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(1)          A local government is not liable to an action for defamation in relation to any of the following done by the local government as required or authorised under this Part —<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(a)          publicly broadcasting a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(b)          making a recording of a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(c)          making a recording of a meeting publicly available;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(d)          retaining a recording of a meeting or a copy of a recording;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(e)          providing a copy of a recording of a meeting to the Departmental CEO.</span></p>
</div>

                          <div class="meetings-intro"><p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the third (3rd) Wednesday of each month, commencing at 3pm. Meetings are not held in the month of January.</p>
<p>Members of the public are encouraged to attend Council meetings. Specific guidelines and procedures apply to the asking of questions at a Council meeting. The <a href="https://www.cranbrook.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/Public-Question-Time-Rules.pdf">guidelines for Public Question Time can be downloaded here</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Recording of Meetings</strong></p>
<ul data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)">
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">All Council Meetings are digitally recorded, for audio only, except for Confidential Agenda Items (in accordance with Section 5.23(2) of the Local Government Act 1995) during which time recording ceases.</li>
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">Following publication and distribution of the meeting minutes to Council Members the digital audio recording will be available on the Shire’s website.</li>
</ul>
<div data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)"></div>
<p><u data-ogsc="">Defamation – cl 14K Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996</u></p>
<p data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)" data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)"><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(1)          A local government is not liable to an action for defamation in relation to any of the following done by the local government as required or authorised under this Part —<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(a)          publicly broadcasting a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(b)          making a recording of a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(c)          making a recording of a meeting publicly available;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(d)          retaining a recording of a meeting or a copy of a recording;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(e)          providing a copy of a recording of a meeting to the Departmental CEO.</span></p>
</div>

                          <div class="meetings-intro"><p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the third (3rd) Wednesday of each month, commencing at 3pm. Meetings are not held in the month of January.</p>
<p>Members of the public are encouraged to attend Council meetings. Specific guidelines and procedures apply to the asking of questions at a Council meeting. The <a href="https://www.cranbrook.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/Public-Question-Time-Rules.pdf">guidelines for Public Question Time can be downloaded here</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Recording of Meetings</strong></p>
<ul data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)">
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">All Council Meetings are digitally recorded, for audio only, except for Confidential Agenda Items (in accordance with Section 5.23(2) of the Local Government Act 1995) during which time recording ceases.</li>
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">Following publication and distribution of the meeting minutes to Council Members the digital audio recording will be available on the Shire’s website.</li>
</ul>
<div data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)"></div>
<p><u data-ogsc="">Defamation – cl 14K Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996</u></p>
<p data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)" data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)"><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(1)          A local government is not liable to an action for defamation in relation to any of the following done by the local government as required or authorised under this Part —<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(a)          publicly broadcasting a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(b)          making a recording of a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(c)          making a recording of a meeting publicly available;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(d)          retaining a recording of a meeting or a copy of a recording;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(e)          providing a copy of a recording of a meeting to the Departmental CEO.</span></p>
</div>

                          <div class="meetings-intro"><p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the third (3rd) Wednesday of each month, commencing at 3pm. Meetings are not held in the month of January.</p>
<p>Members of the public are encouraged to attend Council meetings. Specific guidelines and procedures apply to the asking of questions at a Council meeting. The <a href="https://www.cranbrook.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/Public-Question-Time-Rules.pdf">guidelines for Public Question Time can be downloaded here</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Recording of Meetings</strong></p>
<ul data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)">
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">All Council Meetings are digitally recorded, for audio only, except for Confidential Agenda Items (in accordance with Section 5.23(2) of the Local Government Act 1995) during which time recording ceases.</li>
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">Following publication and distribution of the meeting minutes to Council Members the digital audio recording will be available on the Shire’s website.</li>
</ul>
<div data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)"></div>
<p><u data-ogsc="">Defamation – cl 14K Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996</u></p>
<p data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)" data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)"><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(1)          A local government is not liable to an action for defamation in relation to any of the following done by the local government as required or authorised under this Part —<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(a)          publicly broadcasting a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(b)          making a recording of a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(c)          making a recording of a meeting publicly available;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(d)          retaining a recording of a meeting or a copy of a recording;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(e)          providing a copy of a recording of a meeting to the Departmental CEO.</span></p>
</div>

                          <div class="meetings-intro"><p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the third (3rd) Wednesday of each month, commencing at 3pm. Meetings are not held in the month of January.</p>
<p>Members of the public are encouraged to attend Council meetings. Specific guidelines and procedures apply to the asking of questions at a Council meeting. The <a href="https://www.cranbrook.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/Public-Question-Time-Rules.pdf">guidelines for Public Question Time can be downloaded here</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Recording of Meetings</strong></p>
<ul data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)">
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">All Council Meetings are digitally recorded, for audio only, except for Confidential Agenda Items (in accordance with Section 5.23(2) of the Local Government Act 1995) during which time recording ceases.</li>
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">Following publication and distribution of the meeting minutes to Council Members the digital audio recording will be available on the Shire’s website.</li>
</ul>
<div data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)"></div>
<p><u data-ogsc="">Defamation – cl 14K Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996</u></p>
<p data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)" data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)"><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(1)          A local government is not liable to an action for defamation in relation to any of the following done by the local government as required or authorised under this Part —<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(a)          publicly broadcasting a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(b)          making a recording of a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(c)          making a recording of a meeting publicly available;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(d)          retaining a recording of a meeting or a copy of a recording;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(e)          providing a copy of a recording of a meeting to the Departmental CEO.</span></p>
</div>

                          <div class="meetings-intro"><p>Ordinary Meetings of Council are held on the third (3rd) Wednesday of each month, commencing at 3pm. Meetings are not held in the month of January.</p>
<p>Members of the public are encouraged to attend Council meetings. Specific guidelines and procedures apply to the asking of questions at a Council meeting. The <a href="https://www.cranbrook.wa.gov.au/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/Public-Question-Time-Rules.pdf">guidelines for Public Question Time can be downloaded here</a>.</p>
<p><strong>Recording of Meetings</strong></p>
<ul data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)">
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">All Council Meetings are digitally recorded, for audio only, except for Confidential Agenda Items (in accordance with Section 5.23(2) of the Local Government Act 1995) during which time recording ceases.</li>
<li data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">Following publication and distribution of the meeting minutes to Council Members the digital audio recording will be available on the Shire’s website.</li>
</ul>
<div data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)"></div>
<p><u data-ogsc="">Defamation – cl 14K Local Government (Administration) Regulations 1996</u></p>
<p data-ogsc="rgb(0, 0, 0)" data-ogsb="rgb(255, 255, 255)"><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(1)          A local government is not liable to an action for defamation in relation to any of the following done by the local government as required or authorised under this Part —<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(a)          publicly broadcasting a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(b)          making a recording of a meeting;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(c)          making a recording of a meeting publicly available;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(d)          retaining a recording of a meeting or a copy of a recording;<br />
</span><span data-ogsc="rgb(36, 36, 36)">(e)          providing a copy of a recording of a meeting to the Departmental CEO.</span></p>
</div>
